retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for 1990s-style album covers featuring a high-contrast silhouette profile paired with a naturalistic, warm-toned portrait.
triggerTerms: warm gradient background with serif text

recipe.visualDefinition: A composite image featuring a large, high-contrast dark silhouette on the left and a soft-focus, warm-lit portrait of a woman on the right, set against a peach-to-yellow gradient background with bold serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Silhouette on the left facing the portrait on the right
Warm peach background unifying the two subjects
Typography placed in the upper right and lower left corners
Contrast between the flat dark silhouette and the dimensional portrait
coreInvariants: Serif typography in red and black

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large silhouette occupies the left third; a medium-shot portrait occupies the right two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's face in the portrait, specifically her eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large red text in the top right, down to the portrait's face, then across to the silhouette and bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The gradient background provides breathing room between the two main subjects.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background and accents; natural skin tones in the portrait.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a high-contrast serif with sharp terminals
Secondary text uses a wide-tracked, condensed sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 't' in the primary text has a prominent crossbar
Lowercase 'a' in the primary text is a double-story form
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for branding paired with a wide-tracked sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic high-contrast serif look of the 90s
Matches the clean, condensed sans-serif for the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a composite image with a dark, high-contrast silhouette profile on the left and a warm-toned portrait of a woman with curly hair on the right, against a peach-to-yellow gradient background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase serif text in red at the top right and wide-tracked condensed sans-serif text at the bottom left, ensuring one letter in the bottom text is red.

verificationChecks: Is the silhouette on the left high-contrast?
Is the background a warm peach/yellow gradient?
Is the top right text a bold red serif?

mustRedesign: Generic sans-serif for the main title

mustAchieve: Balanced composite of silhouette and face

postGenerationChecks: Check for the red accent letter in the bottom text
Ensure the silhouette does not obscure the portrait's face
Verify the peach gradient is smooth
Confirm the serif font has high contrast
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Silhouette Profile] + [Warm Portrait] + [Peach Gradient] + [Red Serif Typography] to recreate the 90s pop aesthetic.
